BypassActor.description:
An actor that may bypass the ruleset, written by name. ghrs resolves the name to the API's
`actor_id`.

mode.description: `pull_request` is for branch rulesets only, and not for `deploy_key`

name.description:
App slug (`self` for the App ghrs runs as), team slug, or role name (`maintain`, `write`
or `admin`). Only `integration` accepts a numeric App ID, for private Apps of someone else.
Omitted for `organization_admin` and `deploy_key`, which refer to the whole type and have
no ID.

max_coverage_drop.description:
Pull requests whose line coverage drops more than this many percentage points from the
default branch are blocked

minimum_coverage.description: Pull requests with line coverage below this are blocked

severity.description: Lowest severity of code quality findings that must be resolved before merging

code_scanning_tools.description: Tools that must provide code scanning results

alerts_threshold.description: Alert severity at which results block a ref update

security_alerts_threshold.description: Security severity at which results block a ref update

tool.description: Name of the code scanning tool

Collaborator.description: The repository owner cannot be declared. On a personal repository, only `push` is available.

permission.description: Repository role granted to the user

Conditions.description:
Refs the ruleset applies to (`conditions.ref_name` in the API). Patterns start with
`refs/heads/` for branch rulesets and `refs/tags/` for tag rulesets, except `~ALL` and (branch
rulesets only) `~DEFAULT_BRANCH`.

exclude.description: Ref patterns excluded even when `include` matches them (fnmatch syntax)

include.description: Ref patterns the ruleset applies to (fnmatch syntax)

review_draft_pull_requests.description: Copilot also reviews draft pull requests

review_on_push.description: Copilot reviews each new push to a pull request

DismissalRestriction.description:
Organization-owned repositories only. `enabled` is required unless the ruleset already has
a restriction, whose keys not written here keep their current values

allowed_actors.description: Actors allowed to dismiss pull request reviews

check_response_timeout_minutes.description:
Minutes a required status check has to report a conclusion before it is assumed to
have failed

grouping_strategy.description:
`ALLGREEN`: the merge commit for each pull request in a group must pass the required
checks. `HEADGREEN`: only the commit at the head of the group must pass them

max_entries_to_build.description: Number of queued pull requests requesting checks and workflow runs at the same time

max_entries_to_merge.description: Maximum number of pull requests merged together in a group

merge_method.description: Method used to merge queued pull requests

min_entries_to_merge.description: Minimum number of pull requests merged together in a group

min_entries_to_merge_wait_minutes.description:
Minutes to wait for `min_entries_to_merge` after the first pull request is queued.
After that, a smaller group is merged

Meta.description:
The target repository. --repo takes precedence over it, and without either, the target is
taken from the git remote.

owner.description: User or Organization that owns the repository

name.description: How the rule appears in GitHub's settings

negate.description: Fails the rule when the pattern matches, instead of when it does not

operator.description: How `pattern` is compared with the value

pattern.description: The string or regular expression to match

allowed_merge_methods.description: Merge methods allowed for pull requests. At least one is required

dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push.description: New reviewable commits dismiss previous approvals

require_code_owner_review.description:
Pull requests that modify files with a designated code owner need an approval from
one

require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_.description:
Requires one more approval than `required_approving_review_count` on pull requests
Copilot opens under its own app identity, not on behalf of a person. No effect when zero
approvals are required. GitHub enables it when omitted. Not in the REST API
description; the meaning is from GitHub's ruleset docs (public preview)

require_last_push_approval.description: The most recent reviewable push must be approved by someone other than its pusher

required_approving_review_count.description: Number of approving reviews required before a pull request can be merged

required_review_thread_resolution.description: All conversations on code must be resolved before a pull request can be merged

required_reviewers.description: Teams that must review changes to matching files

Repository.description:
Repository settings, with the names of `PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}`. Only the fields that are
written are compared. Unwritten fields are left untouched.

allow_merge_commit.description: Allows merging pull requests with a merge commit

default_branch.description: Default branch. The branch must already exist

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Deletes head branches automatically when pull requests are merged

description.description: A short description of the repository

has_discussions.description:
Enables discussions. `PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}` does not document it; the repository
object documents it as whether discussions are enabled

homepage.description: A URL with more information about the repository

visibility.description: Rulesets are not available on private repositories on the free plan

required_deployment_environments.description: Environments that must be deployed to successfully before a branch can be merged

file_patterns.description:
Pull requests changing files that match these patterns (fnmatch syntax) need the
reviewer's approval

minimum_approvals.description:
Approvals required from the reviewer. `0` adds the team to the pull request without
requiring its approval

reviewer.description: The team that reviews matching files

RequiredStatusChecks.description:
Keys differ from the API's: `require_up_to_date` is
`strict_required_status_checks_policy`, and `checks` is `required_status_checks`.

do_not_enforce_on_create.description: Refs can be created even when a check would otherwise prohibit it

require_up_to_date.description: Branches must be up to date with the base branch before merging

ReviewActor.description:
An actor in `pull_request`, written by name like a bypass actor. ghrs resolves the name to the
API's `id`. `required_reviewers` accepts only `team`, and a `repository_role` in
`dismissal_restriction` must be `admin`.

name.description:
Team slug, role name, user login, or App slug (`self` for the App ghrs runs as). An App
is sent as its installation ID in the Organization

type.description: The kind of actor `name` refers to

Rules.description:
Rules of a ruleset. Rules not written here are disabled.

Rules GitHub has but this table lacks cannot be declared. plan keeps them at their current
values instead of disabling them, so a rule GitHub adds later is not deleted.

Fields are named by the API's rule type, so `KEYS` lists rule types. The renames follow
`schema::RULE_NAMES`.

block_force_pushes.description: Only bypass actors can force push to matching refs

branch_name_pattern.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

code_coverage.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

code_quality.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

code_scanning.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

commit_author_email_pattern.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

commit_message_pattern.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

committer_email_pattern.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

copilot_code_review.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

license_compliance_scanning.description: Added or changed dependencies must comply with the Organization's license policy

merge_queue.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

pull_request.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

required_deployments.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

required_linear_history.description: Prevents merge commits from being pushed to matching refs

required_signatures.description: Commits pushed to matching refs must have verified signatures

required_status_checks.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

restrict_creations.description: Only bypass actors can create matching refs

restrict_deletions.description: Only bypass actors can delete matching refs

restrict_updates.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

tag_name_pattern.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

workflows.description: `true` / `false`, or a table of parameters. `true` keeps the current parameters (the defaults on creation), and parameters not written in a table keep their current values

Ruleset.description: A ruleset of the repository. Rulesets inherited from the Organization are not managed.

bypass_actors.description:
Actors that may bypass the ruleset. Actors not listed lose their bypass, so omitting this
removes every bypass actor

conditions.description: Refs the ruleset applies to. Omitted, it applies to no ref

target.description: Push rulesets are Team / Enterprise only

context.description: Name of the status check (the job name for GitHub Actions)

integration.description: Slug of the App that must report the check. ghrs resolves it to the App ID

permission.description: Repository role granted to the team

update_allows_fetch_and_merge.description: The branch can still pull changes from its upstream repository

WorkflowFile.description:
`repository_id` is a numeric ID, which ghrs cannot resolve from a name yet, so validation
rejects it: a workflow file cannot be declared. `workflows = true` keeps the current ones.

ref.description: Branch or tag of the workflow file to use

repository_id.description: ID of the repository where the workflow is defined

sha.description: Commit SHA of the workflow file to use

do_not_enforce_on_create.description: Refs can be created even when a workflow would otherwise prohibit it

description: Settings of one GitHub repository, declared for ghrs.

collaborator.description:
Direct collaborators keyed by login. Collaborators not declared are kept unless plan /
apply run with --prune

meta.description: The target repository, used when --repo is not given

repository.description: Repository settings. Only the fields written are compared

ruleset.description:
Rulesets keyed by name (`[ruleset.main]`). Rulesets not declared are kept unless plan /
apply run with --prune

team.description:
Teams keyed by slug (Organization-owned repositories only). Teams not declared are kept
unless plan / apply run with --prune

title: ghrs declaration file (.ghrs.toml)
